name: Mini Loader
instructions: omr/instructions/8418-1-1.pdf (the skid loader; book 2, omr/instructions/8418-1-2.pdf, builds the alternate wheel loader)

functions.does: The grey knob at the back (a 12-tooth double bevel gear) raises and lowers the loader arms and bucket: it turns a worm, which turns an 8-tooth gear on a cross axle at the top of the back; the two arms, long axles along the sides, are fixed on that axle's ends and carry the crossbar the bucket clips onto.
functions.source: book 1: page 22 (finished model: arrows on the knob and on the bucket); steps 7 (worm and knob), 14 (8-tooth gear on its axle), 16-18 (arms and crossbar), 19 (bucket)
functions.note: That the arms are fixed on the 8-tooth gear's axle (rather than pushed by levers) is read from the model file. The worm holds the arms wherever they're left.

functions.does: The bucket tilts by hand on its click hinge under the arms' crossbar, holding at each click.
functions.source: book 1: step 19 (bucket on a click hinge); inferred: tilted by hand, nothing drives it

functions.does: The four wheels roll freely on pins; there's no steering (a skid loader).
